premises.text: Privacy regulation and risk lock data away, so AI/data teams wait months through privacy, legal, and security processes
premises.evidence_span: It takes a long time to get access to data. Data is either locked away, or they have to go through a long process, including privacy engineering, legal, and security

premises.text: Platform converts private real data into anonymized synthetic data with the same analytical properties
premises.evidence_span: We convert private real data into 100% anonymized synthetic data that has the same properties as the real data

premises.text: Confidential computing lets jobs run on encrypted data so BetterData never sees plaintext customer data
premises.evidence_span: We introduced confidential computing, where you can compute on encrypted data, so companies don't have to trust us with data because we can't even see it

premises.text: Data tokenization keeps ownership with the company via tamper-proof locks on customer data tokens
premises.evidence_span: data tokenization. Companies own their data fully, and we have tamper-proof locks for that as well

premises.text: Encrypted multi-party collaboration produces shared synthetic views of combined customers without exposing plaintext
premises.evidence_span: companies can collaborate on data sets together and understand more about their combined and common customers, all while the data remains encrypted for all parties involved

premises.text: Licensing/support model covers on-prem, private, and public cloud via APIs or web UI
premises.evidence_span: We have a licensing and support business model, and we support on-premise, private, and public cloud

domains.name: Synthetic data with confidential compute and tokens

value.text: Innovate on data in days while protecting customer privacy
value.evidence_span: allows you to innovate on data in days and not months

causal_links.evidence_span: how can companies innovate on data while protecting their customers' privacy
access data in days and not months, retain full ownership over their data
safely collaborate with others, all while their customer data remains encrypted
APIs integrated directly into your data science pipelines

notes: QA report / model-performance similarity folded into P2 as evidence the synthetic data matches real properties. Bank collaboration demo is illustration of P5. Pilots, grants, and team credentials excluded. Vision that most AI will train on synthetic data treated as framing, not a premise. P2–P4 kept separate as speaker-listed distinct platform capabilities (synthetic generation; confidential compute; tokenization).
